Package index

  • Read data

    • Deaths, exposures and populations in long or wide tables, at any age and period resolution.

    parse_age_labels()
    Parse age-group labels

    mt_read_genesis()
    Read deaths and populations from GENESIS (Destatis) flat files
    mt_read_gbe()
    Read tables exported from GBE-Bund

    mt_group_levels()

    Estimate suppressed death counts
    mt_validate()

    mt_strata() mt_obs() mt_grid() as.data.table(<mt_data>)

    • Common resolution of all tables; ungrouping and smoothing; preprocessing pipelines refitted in backtests.

    Regroup data onto coarser age or period intervals

    Estimate grid-resolution data from grouped observations

    Diagnostics of ungrouped data
    mt_smooth()
    Smooth death rates on the grid
    mt_smooth_check() mt_plot_smooth()
    Check and plot the result of smoothing

    Preprocessing pipelines
    mt_set_grid()

    • Observed indicators with Poisson intervals, gaps between strata, inequality indices, lifespan variation, decompositions and excess mortality (which also work on forecasts).

    prob_dying() asr() yll()
    Derived quantities from forecast draws or observed data
    mt_contrast()
    Differences and ratios between strata, path by path
    mt_plot_contrast()
    Plot gaps between strata over time
    mt_inequality()
    Slope and relative index of inequality, path by path
    lifespan_variation()
    Lifespan variation from rates or forecast draws
    mt_decompose() summary(<mt_decomposition>)
    Decompose differences in mortality by age, cause and subgroup
    mt_plot_decomposition()
    Plot a decomposition
    standard_population()
    Standard populations
    life_table()
    Life tables from death rates on any age axis
    mt_excess() mt_plot_excess()
    Excess mortality

  • Models for one population
    • lee_carter()
    Lee-Carter model
    rwd()
    Random walk with drift on log death rates
    hyndman_ullah()
    Functional demographic model of Hyndman and Ullah (demography)
    coda()
    Compositional data (CoDa) model of life-table deaths
    stmomo()
    Generalised age-period-cohort models (StMoMo)
    stanmomo()
    Bayesian stochastic mortality models in Stan (StanMoMo)
    arima_series() ets_series()
    Per-age ARIMA and ETS models
    apc_bayes()
    Bayesian age-period-cohort model (bamp)
    apc_select()
    Choose the random-walk orders of a Bayesian APC model by DIC
    mcmc_control()
    MCMC settings for apc_bayes()

  • Models for several populations and causes
    • li_lee() product_ratio()
    Coherent multi-population models
    coherent_fdm()
    Coherent functional demographic model (product-ratio, demography)
    tucker3()
    Tucker3 tensor model across strata
    cause_shares()
    Coherent multi-cause forecasts with cause shares
    coda_causes()
    Multiple-decrement CoDa model of causes of death (experimental)

    stratified()

    Models with reconciled forecasts
    recalibrated()
    Recalibrate forecast distributions on recent years
    anchored()

    bootstrapped()
    Bootstrap uncertainty of preprocessing and parameters
    mt_tune() tuned()
    Tune model and preprocessing settings by forecast accuracy
    mt_hierarchy()

    mt_reconcile()

    mt_aggregate_draws()

    mt_order_strata()
